items.title: Eminem Publisher Eight Mile Style Files Amended Suno Copyright and DMCA Suit, Adding 100+ Allegedly Infringing Outputs — ‘Lose Yourself,’ ‘Without Me,’ and More
items.summary: Suno is facing yet another expanded copyright infringement lawsuit – this time from Eminem publisher Eight Mile Style, which has joined Elvis Presley Enterprises, Reservoir, and others in bolstering its high-stakes claims. Eight Mile made the amended action official yesterday, less than two weeks after initially suing…

items.title: DistroKid Hands Over AI Music Data in Suno Copyright Lawsuit
Reservoir Expands Its Suno and Anthropic Infringement Lawsuits; Publisher Now Seeks Nearly $450 Million in Statutory Damages
items.summary: Reservoir Media has supersized its Suno and Anthropic copyright infringement complaints, which are now demanding a combined total of nearly $450 million in statutory damages. New York City-headquartered Reservoir fired off the expanded actions yesterday, weeks after submitting the original complaints. As we broke down…

items.title: Suno Wants Into Your DAW: ‘Bridge’ Beta Starts With Ableton Live 12 on Mac
items.summary: German music software company Ableton is the guinea pig on “Suno Bridge,” an initiative by the AI music heavyweight to integrate into the most popular DAWs. It might seem like a rough time for Suno to be rolling out new products, as the AI music company and its partners are actively facing major copyright infringement…

items.title: Producer sues Travis Scott, Don Toliver, and Sony Music, claiming he owns half the master of JackBoys track ‘What To Do?’
items.summary: Early Yellow claims Sony and Epic filed false counter-notices to get the 2019 track back on Spotify, Apple Music, and YouTube after his takedowns. Source

items.title: Music may be excluded from Australia’s AI-friendly copyright reforms - though ARIA says “we stand with the rest of the creative and media industries”
items.summary: This week the creative and media industries came together to oppose AI-friendly copyright reforms being considered by the Australian government. It’s now being reported that those reforms might not actually impact on music, though the music industry says it remains committed to the wider campaign

items.title: Australian creative sector bristles at ‘permit’ AI training plans
items.summary: It may seem like we’ve been writing a lot about AI-policy arguments in Australia recently, but there’s a bigger picture. The country’s music industry has been very clear about its belief that if AI companies persuade Australia’s government to weaken copyright protections in regard to training AI models, the ripples wil…

items.title: EXCLUSIVE: Suno Faces Demand To Open New AI Models To Copyright Discovery
Opinion published on Belgium’s new artist-remuneration right
items.summary: Not just any rando’s opinion either: this is an opinion by the advocate general at the Court of Justice of the European Union, Maciej Szpunar, so it carries weight. And the opinion is on a long-running battle over the way Belgium has implemented the European Copyright Directive. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Las canciones creadas íntegramente con IA carecen de derechos de autor
Music Lawsuit Last Week: 2026 AI Copyright Case Updates
Vast majority of consumers want AI music labelled, Deezer survey reveals, as SoundCloud and Spotify update AI policies and tools
items.summary: Deezer has surveyed 9000 consumers in nine markets about their attitudes towards AI music, with 80% of respondents saying AI tracks should be clearly labelled. The new stats coincide with updates from SoundCloud on its AI policies and Spotify on the roll out of its Artist Profile Protection feature

tip.title: Split sheet firmado el mismo día de la sesión
tip.body: Los porcentajes de autoría se pelean cuando la canción pega, no cuando se escribe. Firma el split sheet con todos los presentes antes de salir del estudio, aunque sean amigos.

tip.title: Sign the split sheet the day of the session
tip.body: Songwriting splits get disputed when the song blows up, not when it's written. Sign a split sheet with everyone in the room before you leave the studio —even with friends.
